description: A game's read-only share links to its boards: for a dev log, Discord, a publisher, or a game's own "Live stats" link. With page: makes one to that board page, which anyone with it sees, and nothing else, signed out; no expiry unless days is set; sums (revenue, totals) show only with sums: true; the link is shown once. A share link counts players' sessions only, never bots'. With page and claim: true: a claim link instead, for a game the team made for someone else (bots played a game they posted): its creator opens it, sees that board read only (bots' sessions counted, since they're all the game has) and, signed in or signed up, moves the game into a workspace of their own with its data and dashboard. It works once, expires after days (1, 7, 30 or 90; default 30), and at most 5 can be live per game; not for the demo game. Claiming revokes every key and link the game had, this workspace's keys too, and the game leaves this workspace; its creator gets a new client token. engine (the game's) picks the setup sentence the claim page shows them; promo (a running code such as JAM26) goes on their workspace when they sign up. With revoke: that link (share or claim) stops working at once, for everyone who has it. With neither: lists them all, with kind (share or claim), the page each shows, when it expires, when it was last opened (to about ten minutes) and whether it's revoked or claimed. Ask the person before making or revoking one.

claim.description: With page: make a claim link, which moves the game to its creator's own workspace

days.description: With page: expire after 1, 7, 30, 90 or 365 days (a claim link: 1, 7, 30 or 90, default 30)

engine.description: With claim: the game's engine, for the setup sentence its creator is shown

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name.description: With page: what the link is for, e.g. "Dev log"

page.description: Make a link to this board page (glitchless_dashboard lists their ids)

promo.description: With claim: a running promo code, e.g. "JAM26", put on the creator's workspace when they sign up

revoke.description: Revoke the link with this id (from the list)

service.description: With page: the game's service (default: its most recently active one)

sums.description: With page: show sums such as revenue (not on a claim link)

name: glitchless_share_links
title: Share links
